name: ANSI/IEEE selector switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for selector switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The two-position maintained selector form links an operator position to a defined contact state. A position/contact schedule supplies the full control meaning; the operator label alone cannot describe multiple contact blocks on the same handle.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read the selected position against the contact table.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Operator positions count mechanical choices, while poles count electrical paths.
